title: EngagementStreakAtRiskPayload
description: Payload of `engagement.streak.at_risk` version 1: a streak's week has no order by Saturday 18:00 on its clock: the customer is told once that week, where they agreed to such messages. The envelope's `partner_id` is the campaign's Partner, `null` for the platform's. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

week.description: The week, Monday to Sunday on the clock of its Locations.

weeks.description: Weeks in a row after it.
